Logic Analysis: dependency/build; declares C++17, core library target (excelcore), runtime executable (excel_demo), test executable (excel_tests), enable_testing and add_test
runtime/bootstrap; thin deterministic demo using in-memory streams and public API
automated-test; includes only headers, validates wiring and core rules headlessly
interface; declares data model (Cell, Sheet, Workbook), CSVConfig, ImportResult, import/export API
domain-entity; implements Cell parsing/missing rules, Sheet/Workbook storage and access, robust CSV parse/export
interface; declares ProcessingReport, predicates, selection, sorting, aggregation APIs and types
pure-rule; implements deterministic operations (selection, filtering, numeric predicate, stable sorting, aggregation) and reporting
Test Scope Plan: basic runtime wiring: import in-memory CSV, apply filter predicate, sort with missing last, aggregate numeric, export CSV; assert row counts and header/order in output

core rule: filter treats missing as false; invalid numeric increments report.invalid_cells; missing increments report.missing_cells; aggregate ignores invalid/missing and yields deterministic average only when count_valid>0; ProcessingReport toString() contains expected counts and operations
Shared Knowledge: CMake builds a reusable core library from src/ExcelCore.cpp and src/ExcelOps.cpp, exposes PUBLIC include/ for headers. src/Main.cpp is a thin demo linked against excelcore. tests/test_main.cpp includes only include/ExcelCore.h and include/ExcelOps.h, links excelcore, and runs headlessly via ctest.
Execution Protocol: Run ctest in the build directory. Runtime entry is src/Main.cpp (excel_demo). Single protocol test target is tests/test_main.cpp (excel_tests). No manual interaction or external I/O; tests include headers only and both runtime/test targets link against the core library.
